senses.gloss:
उदृच् f. [उत्कृष्टा ऋक्]
—1 An excellent Ṛk.
—2 Future time.
—3 Remainder, conclusion, end.
—4 Prosperity, rise.

उद्दृश् €1 P.
—1 To see above, look upwards (lit.)
—2 To look into the future; expect; look up to; Mv. 6; उत्पश्यतः सिंहनिपातमुग्रम् R. 2. 60.
—3 To doubt.
—4 To be aware of. ━Caus. To make visible.
